turns.q: I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.
turns.replyTail:
From here, I want to make sure we match you with something that truly fits your situation.

Could you tell me:

What you’re mainly looking for (rose vs other perennial, and any must-haves like fragrance, color, climbing vs bush, cut flowers, etc.)
Your ZIP code or hardiness zone
Where you’ll plant it (full sun vs partial shade, in-ground vs container)

Once I have that, I can narrow it down to a few high-quality options that should suit you well, instead of you having to guess.
